App.SettingsEmpty.zh: 浮绘设置文件为空，请检查

App.ReadKeyboardStateFailed.zh: 无法读取浮绘的本地输入状态。
App.ReadKeyboardStateFailed.en: Could not read the application's input state.

App.UpdateKeyboardStateFailed.zh: 无法更新浮绘的本地键盘状态。
App.UpdateKeyboardStateFailed.en: Could not update the application's keyboard state.

Desktop.FocusLost.zh: 已切换到其他应用，画布进入穿透模式。
Desktop.FocusLost.en: Switched to another application. The canvas is now in pass-through mode.

Desktop.InputReleased.zh: 已释放输入，画布进入穿透模式。
Desktop.InputReleased.en: Input released. The canvas is now in pass-through mode.

Desktop.InputInterrupted.zh: 输入接管已中断，画布进入穿透模式。请重新进入编辑。
Desktop.InputInterrupted.en: Input capture was interrupted. Re-enter edit mode to continue.

Desktop.ChooseOtherHotkey.zh: 请在设置中选择其他快捷键。
Desktop.ChooseOtherHotkey.en: Choose a different shortcut in Settings.

Welcome.Tagline.zh: 在屏幕上画，也能随时回到手边的事。
Welcome.Tagline.en: Draw on your screen and return to what you were doing.

Welcome.Description.zh: 穿透时标注仍然可见。你的画布会自动保留，也可以另存为可编辑工程。
Welcome.Description.en: Annotations stay visible in pass-through mode. Your canvas is recovered automatically and can also be saved as an editable project.

Desktop.CaptureFirst.zh: 请先点击截图，再选择截图范围。
Desktop.CaptureFirst.en: Choose Capture first, then select a region.

Toolbar.Opacity.zh: 标注与贴图的整体透明度

Desktop.EnterEditFailed.en: FloatCanvas · Could not enter edit mode

Text.InvalidNumber.zh: 请输入 1 到 1000000 之间的整数序号。
Text.InvalidNumber.en: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000000.

Text.TargetMissing.zh: 该元素已被删除。输入已保留；可撤销删除后重试，或取消本次编辑。
Text.TargetMissing.en: This element was deleted. Your input has been kept. Undo the deletion and retry, or cancel this edit.

Text.TargetTypeChanged.zh: 元素类型已改变，无法提交此次编辑。输入已保留，请重新打开相应的编辑窗口。
Text.TargetTypeChanged.en: The element type has changed, so this edit cannot be applied. Your input has been kept. Reopen the appropriate editor.

Text.TargetLocked.zh: 该元素已被锁定。输入已保留，解锁后可以重试。
Text.TargetLocked.en: This element is locked. Your input has been kept. Unlock the element and retry.

Text.ActionInProgress.zh: 请先结束画布上的操作。输入已保留。
Text.ActionInProgress.en: Finish the current canvas action first. Your input has been kept.

Text.Busy.zh: 文档正在处理，输入已保留。请稍后重试。
Text.Busy.en: The document is busy. Your input has been kept. Please retry when it is ready.

Text.SessionChanged.zh: 当前画布已切换。输入已保留；返回原画布后重试。
Text.SessionChanged.en: The active canvas has changed. Your input has been kept. Return to the original canvas and retry.

Desktop.Busy.zh: 正在处理图片或文件，请稍候。
Desktop.Busy.en: Processing an image or file. Please wait.

Settings.ModifiersRequired.zh: 请使用 Ctrl、Alt 或 Shift 组合键。
Settings.ModifiersRequired.en: Use a shortcut with Ctrl, Alt, or Shift.

Settings.ToggleHotkey.zh: 编辑 / 穿透：点击后按下组合键
Settings.ToggleHotkey.en: Edit / Pass through: click, then press a shortcut

Settings.HideHotkey.zh: 隐藏 / 恢复：点击后按下组合键
Settings.HideHotkey.en: Hide / Restore: click, then press a shortcut

Settings.ScopeOverrideHint.zh: 启动参数优先；保存的范围在不带屏幕参数启动时生效。
Settings.ScopeOverrideHint.en: The startup flag takes priority. Launch without a screen flag to use the saved scope.

Settings.ScopeRestartHint.zh: 范围修改在下次启动生效。
Settings.ScopeRestartHint.en: Scope changes take effect after restarting FloatCanvas.

Settings.SavedScopeOverride.zh: 设置已保存 · 不带屏幕参数启动时应用所选范围。
Settings.SavedScopeOverride.en: Settings saved. Launch without a screen flag to apply the selected scope.

Settings.SavedScopeRestart.zh: 设置已保存 · 绘图范围下次启动生效。
Settings.SavedScopeRestart.en: Settings saved. The drawing scope will change after restarting FloatCanvas.

Recovery.LoadFailedArchived.zh: 恢复画布失败，原恢复世代已隔离保存在：
Recovery.LoadFailedArchived.en: Could not recover the canvas. Original recovery files were preserved in:

Recovery.LoadFailedPreserved.zh: 恢复画布失败，且无法安全隔离原恢复文件。自动恢复写入已暂停；原文件尚未被覆盖。
Recovery.LoadFailedPreserved.en: Could not recover or safely archive the original recovery files. Automatic recovery writes are paused; the originals have been preserved.

Recovery.PreviousLoaded.zh: 已从前代恢复画布；原恢复世代隔离于
Recovery.PreviousLoaded.en: Recovered the previous canvas. Original recovery files were preserved in

Recovery.PreviousArchiveFailed.zh: 已从前代恢复画布，但无法隔离原恢复世代。自动恢复写入已暂停，原文件不会被覆盖。
Recovery.PreviousArchiveFailed.en: Recovered the previous canvas, but could not archive the original files. Automatic recovery writes are paused; the originals will not be overwritten.

Recovery.ExitSaveFailed.zh: 退出前保存恢复数据失败。画布仍在，修复写入问题后可重试退出。
Recovery.ExitSaveFailed.en: Could not save recovery data before exiting. The canvas is still available; resolve the write error and try exiting again.

Project.ReplaceCurrent.zh: 打开工程将替换当前画布
Project.ReplaceCurrent.en: Opening a project will replace the current canvas

Project.OpenChanged.zh: 画布已变化，本次打开已取消。再次打开即可。
Project.OpenChanged.en: The canvas changed, so opening was cancelled. Try opening the project again.

Project.ReplaceCapture.zh: 打开工程将替换现有截图草稿
Project.ReplaceCapture.en: Opening a project will replace the current capture draft

Project.ReplaceLive.zh: 打开工程将替换现有实时画布
Project.ReplaceLive.en: Opening a project will replace the live canvas

Project.OpenedPassThrough.zh: 工程已打开；已切换到其他应用，保持穿透模式。
Project.OpenedPassThrough.en: Project opened. Another application is active; the canvas remains in pass-through mode.

Project.OpenFailed.zh: 打开工程失败，当前画布已保留。
Project.OpenFailed.en: Could not open the project. The current canvas has been preserved.

Project.SaveFailed.zh: 保存工程失败，画布仍可继续编辑。
Project.SaveFailed.en: Could not save the project. You can continue editing the canvas.

Project.SaveTitle.zh: 保存可编辑的浮绘工程

Project.ReplaceQuestion.zh:
。
是否先另存当前内容？
是：另存；否：放弃；取消：保留当前画布。
Project.ReplaceQuestion.en:
.
Save the current canvas as a separate project first?
Yes: Save as; No: Discard; Cancel: Keep the current canvas.

Export.Failed.zh: 导出失败，画布仍可继续编辑。
Export.Failed.en: Export failed. You can continue editing the canvas.

Clipboard.CopiedObjects.zh: 已复制可编辑对象及透明图片。
Clipboard.CopiedObjects.en: Copied editable objects and a transparent image.

Clipboard.Empty.zh: 剪贴板没有图片或浮绘对象。
Clipboard.Empty.en: The clipboard contains no image or FloatCanvas objects.

Clipboard.InvalidObjects.zh: 剪贴板对象内容无效或过大。
Clipboard.InvalidObjects.en: Clipboard object data is invalid or too large.

Clipboard.InvalidVersion.en: The clipboard object version is not supported.

Clipboard.PasteFailed.zh: 粘贴失败，原画布已保留。
Clipboard.PasteFailed.en: Paste failed. The original canvas has been preserved.

Image.SelectFirst.zh: 请先选中一张可编辑图片。

Image.ImportChanged.zh: 画布或选择已变化，本次导入已取消。
Image.ImportChanged.en: The canvas or selection changed, so importing was cancelled.

Image.ImportFailed.zh: 导入图片失败，原画布已保留。
Image.ImportFailed.en: Could not import the image. The original canvas has been preserved.

Image.Replaced.zh: 图片已替换，位置与效果已保留。
Image.Replaced.en: Image replaced. Its position and effects were preserved.

Capture.ReplaceDraft.zh: 开始新截图将替换现有截图草稿
Capture.ReplaceDraft.en: A new capture will replace the current capture draft

Capture.FocusLost.zh: 已切换到其他应用，截图草稿已保留，可从更多菜单继续编辑。
Capture.FocusLost.en: Switched to another application. The capture draft is preserved; resume it from More.

Capture.SelectRegion.zh: 拖动选择截图范围；Esc 返回实时画布并保留草稿。
Capture.SelectRegion.en: Drag to select a capture region. Esc returns to the live canvas and preserves the draft.

Capture.PrimaryFrozen.zh: 主屏已冻结，可继续编辑。
Capture.PrimaryFrozen.en: Primary screen frozen. You can continue editing.

Capture.AllFrozen.zh: 全部屏幕已冻结，可继续编辑。
Capture.AllFrozen.en: All screens frozen. You can continue editing.

Capture.Failed.zh: 截图失败，实时画布和原截图草稿已保留。
Capture.Failed.en: Capture failed. The live canvas and original capture draft have been preserved.

Capture.RegionSelected.zh: 截图范围已确定，可继续编辑或导出。
Capture.RegionSelected.en: Capture region selected. Continue editing or export the image.

Capture.ReturnedLive.zh: 实时画布 · 截图草稿已保留。

Capture.ProtectedRegions.zh: 部分系统保护区域已遮盖，其余截图可正常编辑。
Capture.ProtectedRegions.en: Some protected areas were masked. The rest of the capture can be edited normally.

Welcome.Shortcuts.zh:
{0}  编辑 / 穿透
{1}  隐藏 / 恢复
Esc  取消操作或返回穿透
Welcome.Shortcuts.en:
{0}  Edit / Pass through
{1}  Hide / Restore
Esc  Cancel or return to pass-through mode

Settings.LanguageRestartHint.zh: 语言修改在下次启动生效，不会改变输入法或画布内容。
Settings.LanguageRestartHint.en: Language changes take effect after restarting FloatCanvas. Your input method and canvas content are unaffected.

Settings.LanguageSaved.zh: 设置已保存 · 语言修改在下次启动生效。
Settings.LanguageSaved.en: Settings saved. The language will change after restarting FloatCanvas.
